analysis.executive_summary: Fireblocks developer documentation spans 724 crawled pages with 21 confirmed broken internal links and 3 unverified URLs. API reference coverage is critically low at 0.61% despite 622 API pages detected, indicating severe usage documentation gaps. Example code reliability scored 0% across all 724 pages, flagged as a likely detection limitation for JavaScript-rendered blocks. Retrieval readiness is weak (58.62/100) driven by 85.41% stale risk and only 7.73% of pages displaying last-updated metadata. SEO/geo issues affect 27.62% of pages, and only 73.65% of 983 key claims include supporting evidence.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage at 100.14% with 724 pages indexed and no repository navigation link breakage
Perfect actionability coverage at 100% and citationability at 100% for AI retrieval
High overall audit confidence at 86.5% with strong crawl confidence at 95%
Large API surface detected (622 pages) provides foundation for coverage improvement
Majority of claims (73.65%) include supporting evidence across 983 detected assertions
risks: API usage documentation at 0.61% coverage creates massive onboarding friction and support burden for 622 API endpoints
Zero detectable example reliability across 724 pages blocks developer self-service and AI answer quality
85.41% stale risk with only 7.73% freshness visibility erodes trust and may surface outdated integration patterns
21 broken internal links disrupt navigation and damage SEO authority across user-facing documentation
27.62% SEO/geo issue rate limits discoverability and organic acquisition of developer users
38.12% chunkability score constrains RAG and LLM citation quality for support automation
26.35% of key claims lack evidence (260 of 983), weakening credibility for compliance and enterprise buyers

prioritized_actions.action: Add usage examples, request/response samples, or integration snippets to the 622 detected API pages to lift 0.61% reference coverage above 40%
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: Closing the 0.61% API usage gap directly reduces time-to-first-call, support ticket volume, and churn for developers integrating 622 endpoints.

prioritized_actions.action: Instrument last-updated timestamps on all pages to raise 7.73% freshness visibility above 80% and reduce 85.41% stale risk perception
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: Freshness signals build trust with enterprise buyers and improve search ranking with minimal engineering lift across 724 pages.

prioritized_actions.action: Fix all 21 confirmed broken internal links to restore navigation flow and recover SEO link equity
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: Broken links create immediate friction in onboarding journeys and signal neglect to search engines and prospects.

prioritized_actions.action: Audit and fix detection for example code blocks (0% reliability on 724 pages) to enable validation and improve AI training corpus quality
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: Validating examples across 724 pages prevents copy-paste errors that spike support costs and accelerates LLM answer accuracy.

prioritized_actions.action: Resolve 27.62% SEO/geo issues (missing meta descriptions, title tags, or structured data) to improve organic developer acquisition
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: SEO fixes on 200+ affected pages compound discoverability gains and reduce paid acquisition dependency over 30 days.

automation_first: Deploy CI link checker to catch the 21 broken internal links at build time and prevent future navigation breakage, reducing manual QA cycles and preserving SEO equity across 724 pages.

Automate last-updated timestamp injection from Git commit history to lift 7.73% freshness coverage to near 100%, eliminating manual metadata maintenance and cutting 85.41% stale risk perception that drives enterprise buyer hesitation.

Implement API reference linter to flag 622 API pages missing usage examples or request/response samples, creating a forcing function to close the 0.61% coverage gap and reduce developer time-to-integration by an estimated 40%.
limitations: External audit cannot verify accuracy of technical claims, code correctness, or whether 622 API endpoints reflect current production behavior.
0% example reliability likely reflects JavaScript rendering or non-standard code block markup; manual inspection required to confirm true example presence and quality.
3 unverified links may be functional but blocked by authentication, rate limiting, or server configuration; manual testing needed for definitive status.
Audit cannot measure actual developer sentiment, support ticket attribution, or conversion impact of the 0.61% API coverage gap without internal analytics correlation.
